column1: # Supplementary Table S1. Candidate lncRNA-mRNA isoforms identified by empiAS.
# 2016 isoforms from 1593 genes in Arabidopsis thaliana (AtRTDv2.1_QUASI.LS reference transcriptome).
# Selection criteria: not translated (polyribosome TPM <= 1.0 in at least one replicate); not NMD-sensitive
# (empiAS FDR >= 0.05 in all four NMD comparisons); nuclear-enriched (empiAS FDR < 0.05 and logFC > 0
# in Nuclear Light vs Nuclear Dark comparison); from multi-isoform genes only.
#   Mean_Nuc_L_TPM        - Mean TPM across the three Nuclear Light replicates (SALMON v1.10.0 quantification)
#   logFC_NucD_vs_NucL    - log2 fold change (Nuclear Dark / Nuclear Light); positive values indicate dark-nuclear enrichment
#   p_value               - empiAS empirical p-value (one-tailed; local window N=1000; logFC cutoff=0.5)
#   FDR_BH                - Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value (false discovery rate)
# Rows are sorted by descending Mean_Nuc_L_TPM.
